description: THE ABEND THAT LANDS AFTER A COMPLETE REPORT BLOCK, and the only case in this folder whose two record channels DISAGREE - five records written, none surviving. That disagreement is the entire subject. case16, case17 and case18 each pin one of the three keyed-lookup not-found arms firing on the FIRST record, where both channels are empty and the difference between them is invisible; this case takes the SAME arm as case17 - 1500-B-LOOKUP-TRANTYPE at app/cbl/CBTRN03C.cbl:494-502 - and fires it on the SECOND record instead. All four state expectedReturnCode 12, because all four reach the single CALL 'CEE3ABD' at :630 (gates G35, G18). WHAT IS SEEDED. TRANFILE holds two fully formed 350-byte CVTRA05Y records, identical except for their identifier, their type code and their amount. Row 1 is completely resolvable: TRAN-ID 'TRN0000000000001' at 1-16, TRAN-TYPE-CD '01' at 17-18, TRAN-CAT-CD 0001 at 19-22, TRAN-SOURCE 'POS TERM  ' at 23-32, TRAN-DESC at 33-132, TRAN-AMT '0000000100{' at 133-143, TRAN-MERCHANT-ID 999999999 at 144-152, name and city at 153-202 and 203-252, zip at 253-262, TRAN-CARD-NUM '0500024453765740' at 263-278, TRAN-ORIG-TS and TRAN-PROC-TS both '2022-03-15-11.22.33.444444' at 279-304 and 305-330, and FILLER PIC X(20) at 331-350 emitted as twenty spaces (gate G21). The amount is written in the zoned sign-overpunch alphabet - '{ABCDEFGHI' carries +0 through +9 and '}JKLMNOPQR' carries -0 through -9 - so the trailing '{' is a positive zero, the field reads 000000010.00, and the value carries scale exactly 2 (gate G23). Row 2 differs in the one byte pair that decides the whole run: TRAN-TYPE-CD is '77' at 17-18. app/data/ASCII/trantype.txt holds exactly seven 60-byte rows whose keys are 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06 and 07, so '77' is not among them and the keyed read at :495 has no path open to it but its INVALID KEY arm. Row 2 is otherwise real and complete rather than a placeholder (practice B1), and its 20.00 is never consumed, because :191-196 lie beyond the abend. CARDXREF, TRANTYPE and TRANCATG are fixture-backed against the genuine files in app/data/ASCII, which are byte-identical to the three copies under src/test/resources/fixtures. cardxref.txt is seeded UNPADDED at its real 36 bytes and the case declares CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50, so the trailing FILLER PIC X(14) that app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy declares is supplied once, at seed time, before anything decodes a row (gate G16, risk R-F). Row 1 of that fixture is 050002445376574000000005000000000050, which is why card 0500024453765740 resolves to XREF-ACCT-ID 00000000050. DATEPARM is one inline 80-byte row - '2022-01-01', one space, '2022-07-06', then 59 spaces - because FD-DATEPARM-REC is PIC X(80) at :88 while WS-DATEPARM-RECORD at :122-125 is X(10) plus a one-byte FILLER plus X(10) = 21 bytes, so the read right-truncates 80 into 21 and the separator is never examined. jobParameters is EMPTY: app/jcl/TRANREPT.jcl:59 gives STEP10R no PARM at all, and 0550-DATEPARM-READ at :220-243 is the only source of WS-START-DATE and WS-END-DATE. THE FIVE WRITES, DERIVED RECORD BY RECORD FROM app/cpy/CVTRA07Y.cpy. Row 1 passes the range test at :173-174, is displayed at :180, breaks the card at :181 because WS-CURR-CARD-NUM is SPACES on entry, and resolves through 1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF at :187; then through 1500-B at :190 to TRAN-TYPE-DESC 'Purchase'; then through 1500-C at :195 - keyed on FD-TRAN-CAT-KEY, the six-byte group FD-TRAN-TYPE-CD X(02) plus FD-TRAN-CAT-CD 9(04) declared at :79-81, here '010001' - to 'Regular Sales Draft'. 1100-WRITE-TRANSACTION-REPORT at :196 then finds WS-FIRST-TIME 'Y' at :275, moves the two dates into REPT-START-DATE and REPT-END-DATE at :277-278 and performs 1120-WRITE-HEADERS at :279, which writes four records and leaves WS-LINE-COUNTER at 4: REPORT-NAME-HEADER, 38 plus 41 plus 12 plus 10 plus 4 plus 10 = 115 bytes right-padded to 133; WS-BLANK-LINE, PIC X(133) VALUE SPACES at :133, already full width; TRANSACTION-HEADER-1, 17 plus 12 plus 19 plus 35 plus 14 plus 1 plus 16 = 114 bytes right-padded; and TRANSACTION-HEADER-2, PIC X(133) VALUE ALL '-' at CVTRA07Y:48, already full width. FUNCTION MOD(WS-LINE-COUNTER, WS-PAGE-SIZE) at :282 is then MOD(4, 20) = 4, not zero, so no page break intervenes; :287-288 adds 10.00 to WS-PAGE-TOTAL and WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL; and 1120-WRITE-DETAIL at :361-374 writes the fifth record. TRANSACTION-DETAIL-REPORT measures 16+1+11+1+2+1+15+1+4+1+29+1+10+4+15+2 = 114 bytes right-padded to 133, in which TRAN-REPORT-AMT PIC -ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.ZZ occupies FIFTEEN print positions - one sign position and fourteen edit positions - at 98-112, with FILLER X(02) at 113-114. Under that mask 10.00 renders as ten spaces then '10.00': the sign position is blank because the value is positive, and Z suppression blanks the eight leading zeros together with both group commas. Counting the mask at fourteen positions instead of fifteen shifts the amount one column to the left, and is the single easiest way to author this record wrongly. THE SEVEN MESSAGES, IN EMISSION ORDER. :160 emits 'START OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBTRN03C'. 0550-DATEPARM-READ reads '00', takes the FIRST arm of the EVALUATE at :222-229, satisfies APPL-AOK and emits 'Reporting from ' plus WS-START-DATE plus ' to ' plus WS-END-DATE at :232-233, which composes to 'Reporting from 2022-01-01 to 2022-07-06'. DISPLAY TRAN-RECORD at :180 then emits each seeded row in full, 350 characters each, once per iteration - the third and fourth lines. On the second iteration :190 reaches the failing lookup, whose INVALID KEY arm emits 'INVALID TRANSACTION TYPE : ' followed by FD-TRAN-TYPE PIC X(02) at :74, giving 'INVALID TRANSACTION TYPE : 77'; moves 23 to IO-STATUS at :498; performs 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS at :499; and performs 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM at :500. THE STATUS LINE IS DERIVED, NOT COPIED. 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS at :633-646 chooses between two renderings on the condition IF IO-STATUS NOT NUMERIC OR IO-STAT1 = '9'. IO-STATUS here holds the two characters '23', which ARE numeric, and IO-STAT1 is '2', not '9', so the condition is false and the ELSE branch at :641-644 runs: MOVE '0000' TO IO-STATUS-04, then MOVE IO-STATUS TO IO-STATUS-04(3:2), which overwrites positions 3 and 4 and leaves '0023'; the DISPLAY then concatenates the literal 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN' with that four-character field, giving 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN0023' - twenty literal characters plus four. The doubled-looking NNNN is literal text in the source rather than a placeholder, and is reproduced verbatim. The branch NOT taken is the binary one at :636-640, which moves IO-STAT1 into IO-STATUS-04(1:1) and packs IO-STAT2 through the TWO-BYTES-BINARY PIC 9(4) BINARY and TWO-BYTES-ALPHA REDEFINES pair at :142-145 before moving the result into IO-STATUS-0403; it renders materially differently and is reachable only for a status that is non-numeric or begins with '9'. It is named again in the coverage note below. THE ABEND. 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM at :626-630 emits 'ABENDING PROGRAM', moves 0 to TIMING, moves 999 to ABCODE and then issues a BARE CALL 'CEE3ABD' with no USING clause. It never returns, so :191-196 do not run for row 2, the six closes at :208-213 do not run, and :215 does not run. CBTRN03C contains ZERO references to RETURN-CODE - the program never sets one - so the 12 asserted here is the RETURN_CODE_IO_ERROR of the common.AbendException contract, applied uniformly at every abend site in this program and therefore identical in case16, case17, case18 and here; a divergence between those four would fail gate G18 for the module. ROUNDED appears zero times in this program and GO TO appears zero times, so every store truncates toward zero (gate G24) and even the abend path is reached by ordinary PERFORM nesting - although the only arithmetic that completes in this case is the single ADD of 10.00 at :287-288. THE TWO CHANNELS. app/jcl/TRANREPT.jcl:76-80 declares TRANREPT as DISP=(NEW,CATLG,DELETE) with DCB=(LRECL=133,RECFM=FB,BLKSIZE=0). The second and third positionals are different outcomes rather than synonyms: a run that reaches GOBACK at :217 leaves the generation catalogued, and a run that does not must leave no generation at all. expectedWrites therefore carries five records and expectedFinalState carries none, and expectedDatasets states BOTH channels explicitly - WRITES rowCount 5 and FINAL_STATE rowCount 0, each at recordLength 133 - because an empty channel has no row for a row-level expectation to address, and omitting it would say only that the case never mentioned the report. Gate G20's 133-byte width and gate G21's intact FILLER are satisfied positively on the writes channel and vacuously on the final-state channel. WHAT DOES NOT HAPPEN, exhaustively. No page total and no grand total record: 1110-WRITE-PAGE-TOTALS at :293 and 1110-WRITE-GRAND-TOTALS at :318 are reachable only from :202-203, inside the AT END arm the abend precedes, or from :283, behind a page break MOD(4, 20) does not trigger. No account total record: 1120-WRITE-ACCOUNT-TOTALS at :306 is reachable only from :183 under WS-FIRST-TIME = 'N', and the one card break in this run happens while it is still 'Y'. No 'TRAN-AMT ' line from :198 and no 'WS-PAGE-TOTAL' line from :199, both of which live in that same AT END arm - which is also why the end-of-file double count this program is known for, pinned by case06, case07 and case15, cannot appear here. No 'END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBTRN03C' from :215. No 'INVALID CARD NUMBER' from :487, because the cross-reference resolved. No 'INVALID TRAN CATG KEY' from :507: 1500-C at :195 sits AFTER 1500-B at :190 and is never reached, even though '770001' is equally absent from the eighteen 60-byte rows of trancatg.txt. And no ERROR line of any kind, because all six opens, both reads, all five writes and every close that ran reported '00'. THE WHEN OTHER ARM OF THE TRANFILE READ, AND WHY THIS CASE CANNOT CARRY IT. 1000-TRANFILE-GET-NEXT at :248-272 reads at :249 and evaluates TRANFILE-STATUS at :251-258 in three arms: WHEN '00' moves 0, WHEN '10' moves 16, and WHEN OTHER - LAST, which is exactly what gate G30 requires - moves 12 into APPL-RESULT PIC S9(9) COMP. 12 satisfies NEITHER 88 APPL-AOK VALUE 0 NOR 88 APPL-EOF VALUE 16 at :150-152, so the guard chain at :260-271 falls through both tests into the innermost ELSE, emits 'ERROR READING TRANSACTION FILE' at :266, moves TRANFILE-STATUS to IO-STATUS at :267 and performs 9910 and 9999 at :268-269. A declarative case in this folder CANNOT reach that arm, and no member was invented to pretend otherwise. The obstruction is structural and was checked in both places it lives. First, the model refuses it: a seeded status is expressed through ScreenRequest.forcedOutcomes, and ParityCase.requireOnlineMember throws when unitKind is BATCH_JOB and screenRequest is present, so a batch case has no forced-outcome member at all - and everyCaseTakesItsRangeFromTheDatasetAndNotFromAParm asserts screenRequest is null for all twenty. Second, the adapter refuses it: CBTRN03CParityTest.ReportRun.invoke builds its collector and its job under Injection.NONE, documented there as the shape all twenty cases run under. The arm is therefore pinned PROGRAMMATICALLY, by CBTRN03CParityTest.aTranFileReadFailureAbendsWithTheStatusItReported, which injects status '35' - neither '00' nor '10', numeric, and not beginning with '9', so 9910 takes the same ELSE branch and renders 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN0035' - and asserts RETURN_CODE_IO_ERROR with nothing written. That rendering differs from the 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN0023' asserted here only in the last two digits, because the three keyed lookups substitute a status of 23 while a failing read reports its own; the derivation path is the identical ELSE branch. Saying so plainly is the point: practice B4 forbids resolving a gap between what a case is asked to express and what the harness can express by quietly writing an expectation no run could produce. THE HONEST COVERAGE NOTE. This folder is capped at exactly twenty declarative cases by AAP section 0.3.8 and gate G15, and ParityHarness.casesOf enforces the count in both directions - it refuses a set short of twenty, naming each absent case, and equally refuses a directory holding anything the twenty do not name. Four reachable arms consequently have no declarative case of their own; they are covered by the module's unit tests, where the 90 per cent branch bar of gates G49 and G50 lives, and they are named here rather than left as a silent gap (practices B4 and B12). First, the WHEN OTHER arm of the EVALUATE DATEPARM-STATUS at :227-228, which emits 'ERROR READING DATEPARM FILE' at :238 and abends before a single transaction is read; its '10' arm is what case19 pins and its '00' arm is what every other case takes. Second, the failure arm of 1111-WRITE-REPORT-REC at :346-358, whose IF has only two arms because a WRITE has no end-of-file outcome, so it moves 0 or 12 and never 16 and APPL-EOF is never tested, emitting 'ERROR WRITING REPTFILE' at :354 - covered by aRefusedReportWriteAbendsAndDiscardsTheGeneration. Third, the binary branch of 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS at :636-640, reachable only for a non-numeric status or one beginning with '9'. Fourth, the open and close failure texts, none of which any seeded row can provoke: 'ERROR OPENING TRANFILE' at :387, 'ERROR OPENING REPTFILE' at :405, 'ERROR OPENING CROSS REF FILE' at :423, 'ERROR OPENING TRANSACTION TYPE FILE' at :441, 'ERROR OPENING TRANSACTION CATG FILE' at :459, 'ERROR OPENING DATE PARM FILE' at :477, 'ERROR CLOSING POSTED TRANSACTION FILE' at :525, 'ERROR CLOSING REPORT FILE' at :543, 'ERROR CLOSING CROSS REF FILE' at :562, 'ERROR CLOSING TRANSACTION TYPE FILE' at :580, 'ERROR CLOSING TRANSACTION CATG FILE' at :598 and 'ERROR CLOSING DATE PARM FILE' at :616 - of which aTranTypeOpenFailureAbendsBeforeAnythingIsWritten and aReportCloseFailureAbendsAfterACompleteReport pin two directly. THREE LITERALS THAT ARE EASILY CONFUSED, and none of which appears in this case: the READ failure text is 'ERROR READING TRANSACTION FILE' at :266 - TRANSACTION, not TRANFILE - while the OPEN failure text for that same file is 'ERROR OPENING TRANFILE' at :387 and its CLOSE failure text is 'ERROR CLOSING POSTED TRANSACTION FILE' at :525, which is in turn distinct from the report file's own 'ERROR CLOSING REPORT FILE' at :543. Four different literals across two files and three operations; each belongs only to the paragraph that emits it. BEHAVIOUR IS PRESERVED, NOT IMPROVED (practice B5). The program abends on an unresolvable transaction type rather than skipping the record, substituting a default description or degrading to a partial report, and it discards a report it had already written five records into. Both are the behaviour, and this case asserts them rather than what a redesign would prefer. Nothing under app/cbl, app/cpy, app/jcl, app/proc or app/data was modified to author it (practice B3), the failing condition is a fixed byte pair rather than anything probabilistic (practice B7), and the code page is stated as US-ASCII rather than taken from the platform (practice B8). PROVENANCE (practice B12, risk R-A). Every value above is STATICALLY DERIVED by structured reading of app/cbl/CBTRN03C.cbl, cross-checked against the byte layouts of app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy, CVTRA03Y.cpy, CVTRA04Y.cpy, CVACT03Y.cpy and CVTRA07Y.cpy, the DD and DCB contracts of app/jcl/TRANREPT.jcl and app/proc/TRANREPT.prc, and the real fixtures in app/data/ASCII. None of it is captured from, recorded against or replayed from an execution of the legacy COBOL, which AAP section 0.7.6 documents as empirically impossible in this environment across eight verified blockers - no z/OS runtime, an indexed-file handler the available compiler reports as disabled, and no Language Environment CEE services, so CEE3ABD cannot be called at all. Only the PROVENANCE of the expected values is substituted; the twenty cases, the field-for-field diffing and the diff-count-equals-zero gate are all preserved. review_rules returns exactly one line, 'No user rules provided.', so no user rule governs this file and the binding standard is the enterprise-practice set B1 to B12.
